text:
Priya: kicking off CustConstella LoRA bring-up into release/1.2.0-serving. scope: merge sanity check, nf4-int4 and experimental int3 quant smoke, and a tiny 25-30 example quickpack for product. pinging @Noah for prompt set exports.
Noah: on it 12 I have Constella_prompts_120.csv. will scrub PII and export constella-mini30.json (25 examples) biased to payments + edge locales. uploading to s3 after export.
Elena: small heads-up 6a7 after applying the graft i see a tokenizer mapping shift for euro sign. snippet: ```- token 411: "\u20ac" -> 500
+ token 411: "\u20ac" -> 501``` leads to an extra space token in short templates on detokenize. may explain missing leading chars in tiny outputs.
Carlos: customer ticket mentioned amounts losing leading zeros when currency present (e.g. "$007.00" -> "7.00"). sounds like detokenize/normalize mismatch rather than numeric rounding.
Priya: don't rewrite the base tokenizer now. plan: add a token_remap in the model manifest + small serving postprocess to canonicalize currency tokens. Elena, can you draft the manifest snippet?
Elena: sure, example I'm testing: ```json
{"model": "constella-lora-v2", "token_remap": {"411": "500"}}
``` will push as a manifest diff.
Ravi: quant test plan: fp16 baseline -> nf4-int4 (fast path) -> int3 (experimental, kv_cache disabled). metrics to log: EM on key fields (amount,date,currency), hallucination count (fabricated amounts), fluency (human flag 0/1), P50/P95 latency streaming vs non-streaming, and cost delta.
DevBot: CI queued: run/eng-ml/constella-bringup/3532101234. will post logs here. :robot_face:
DevBot: run/eng-ml/constella-bringup/3532101234 -> started on a100-80gb. config:
```yaml
model: constella-lora-v2
base: small-sage-7b
quant: nf4-int4
kv_cache: enabled
batch: 8
max_tokens: 48
evalpack: constella-mini30.json
```
Noah: uploaded constella-mini30.json to s3://redwood-evals/constella/mini30_v1.json and included gold labels for amount/currency/date. link: https://s3.redwood/constella/mini30_v1.json
Ravi: int4 run (first pass, 25 examples): EM-fields fp16 0.935 -> int4 0.927, fluency fp16 0.99 -> int4 0.975, P95 latency fp16 200ms -> int4 150ms, cost per token ~ -35%. observed 1 case of amount rounding where cents dropped.
Priya: good signal. start int3 but mark it experimental in the job name. if hallucination rate exceeds 5% we won't promote.
DevBot: run/eng-ml/constella-bringup/3532101234-int3 -> started (kv_cache disabled).
Ravi: int3 full results: EM-fields 0.88, fluency 0.90, hallucinations: 4/25 (fabricated amounts), P95 110ms. detailed breakdown and token-level perplexities at /runs/3532101234/int3/summary.json.
Carlos: please add a serving-side assertion to canonicalize currency tokens after detokenize so fp16/int4/int3 outputs are deterministic for short templates. otherwise product tests will see spurious diffs.
Elena: pushed the token_remap manifest change to my branch (wip) and added a small unit test for detokenize canonicalization. pr link forthcoming.
Priya: action items: (1) Noah finalize mini30 with 3 adversarial currency/date cases, (2) Elena commit manifest remap + unit test, (3) Ravi upload full artifacts and run summary, (4) Carlos add postprocess assertion in serving smoke jobs. we'll collect all and present to product tomorrow.
Noah: updated mini30_v2.json with 3 adversarial entries (locale: fr_FR with \u20ac, fallthrough dates, leading-zero amounts). uploaded to same s3 path.
DevBot: run/eng-ml/constella-bringup/3532101234 -> completed (status: WARN). artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/constella/3532101234/artifacts.tar.gz
Priya: thanks all. i'll open a small PR bundling the manifest remap, the regression test, and the CI smoke step. if int3 regressions remain high we'll ship int4 with an automatic fallback to fp16 for payment routes.
Carlos: +1. i'll add the serving assertion PR after Elena's manifest PR lands.
Ravi: logs and perf traces uploaded: /runs/3532101234/artifacts/, plus cost estimate sheet in artifacts.tar.gz.
Noah: added one synthetic regression test for amount normalization into the regression suite (tests/evals/amount_norm_test.py). will gate canary on that.
Priya: perfect. closing thread once PRs are green. :white_check_mark:
